[[File:Jared Napolitano 2020 Volunteer Award.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Jared Napolitano with his 2020 Volunteer Award.]]
'''Jared Napolitano''' (GEMP handle '''jnapolit31''')<ref name="cc1" /> is listed as '''[[Marketing Advocate]]''' on public Players Committee organization charts, with forum handle '''Jnapolit31'''.<ref name="orgchart2021">PC Organization Chart PDF, CreationDate 8 July 2021; [https://web.archive.org/web/20211005193353/https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf Wayback 5 October 2021]</ref><ref name="orgchart2024">PC Organization Chart PDF, CreationDate 6 May 2024; [https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf live orgchart.pdf]</ref>

He opened the [[2022 Retro League]] season thread and its event threads as Jnapolit31.<ref name="t80048">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=80048 2022 Retro GEMP League], forum.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012160247/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t80048.html Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="t80194">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=80194 Event #1 - 2022 Retro GEMP League - P-ANH Constructed], forum.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012160423/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t80194.html Internet Archive].</ref>
